mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 5% and the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for three consecutive months and the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 1% MoM and the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the real GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy impacting economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% and the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases, but the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for three consecutive months and the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% and the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
